title: Personalized Basketball Burning Flames Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Transform your bedroom into a court of dreams with this personalized sport comforter. Designed for true basketball fans, this custom bedding set allows you to add your own name and number, making it a truly unique piece of sports decor. Crafted from soft, lightweight, and durable brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling, it provides the perfect balance of cozy warmth and lightweight comfort for all seasons.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Custom options let you add your own name (up to 30 characters) and number (up to 5 digits) for a one-of-a-kind bedding set.
  • Comfort & Warmth: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Vibrant & Durable: Advanced environmental protection finishing process ensures deep dye holding and prevents fading over time.
  • All-Season Use: Lightweight, soft, and breathable material makes this comforter set perfect for comfortable use throughout the year.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly on low or no heat to restore its fluffy loft.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D13
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Compact
Customization Name and Number (2 text inputs)
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
